candidateObjectiveEnglish: Name a roll, wrinkle, fastener and inch; describe absence in a language example and ask where the manufacturer instructions are.
grammarExplanationEnglish: "This is a" + singular noun identifies an item: "This is a roll." "There are no" + plural noun describes absence: "There are no wrinkles." "Where are the" + plural noun asks for location: "Where are the manufacturer instructions?"
grammarExplanationFrench: « This is a » + nom singulier identifie un objet : « This is a roll. » « There are no » + nom pluriel décrit une absence : « There are no wrinkles. » « Where are the » + nom pluriel demande un emplacement : « Where are the manufacturer instructions? »
